title: Design System: MARVIN (native macOS app)
derivedFrom: Swift source under macos/MARVIN, not checked against renders. See DESIGN.md provenance note.

git-added-dark.note: unchanged from the original single-value token

git-added-light.note: same hue as dark, lightness lowered to >=4.5:1 on every light surface (5.61 on content, 4.51 on row-selected)

pane-title.purpose: Title row of every left pane; uppercase, tracked, muted.

section-header.purpose: Section label with optional count capsule.

empty-headline.purpose: What a pane says when it has nothing to show.

chat-meta.purpose: Role gutter, tool rows, streaming label: .caption monospaced.

shadows.name: popup-ambient
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the views: the slash-command popup. SwiftUI: .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 12, y: 4).

componentsNote: The sidecar schema's components carry self-contained HTML/CSS snippets for a web panel. MARVIN's UI is native SwiftUI/AppKit and is not web-renderable, so none are synthesized; DESIGN.md Components describes them with source citations instead.

narrative.overview: MARVIN's shell is a dense, flat tool that recedes so the work (code, a plan, a diff, a confirm) leads. Regions are separated by hairline borders, not by fill contrast, in two close greys sampled from Antigravity/VS Code chrome. Native macOS controls, the system accent, SF Pro for interface text, SF Mono for anything code-like, and SF Symbols sit on top.
keyCharacteristics: Two surface greys 1–2 steps apart; hairline borders do the separating.
Light and dark both ship, as fixed hex pairs resolved per appearance, not as derived system colors.
Dense, small chrome type with a fixed-point scale; semantic text styles in the transcript.
Monospace is a first-class voice (tool rows, role labels, notice detail, editor), not just code.
Hover is a real affordance; press feedback is a 0.97 scale and a deeper fill.
The system accent is the only chromatic brand color; the app defines none of its own.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by a 0.5–1 pt MarvinTheme.border, not by fill contrast. Surfaces stay within one or two greys of each other.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The only chromatic brand color is the system accent, and at most one accent-filled (primary) chip appears per group.

rules.name: The Outcome Color Rule
rules.body: Green, orange and red mean outcome and are paired with a distinct glyph, because a red word among tinted status text is just another tinted word.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Tool names, paths, role labels, counts and diagnostics set in SF Mono; prose in SF Pro.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Pane and section titles are uppercase, tracked +0.4, muted. A user-supplied name (the project) is never uppercased.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. A shadow or material is an exception that needs a reason.

rules.name: The No-Overshoot Rule
rules.body: Control animation is critically damped (extraBounce: 0); nothing bounces.

dos: Do use MarvinTheme colors for shell surfaces and text, so appearance switching stays consistent.
Do separate regions with MarvinDivider / MarvinTheme.border, not with a darker fill.
Do build left-pane UI from the ADR-0114 vocabulary (PaneHeader, PaneSectionHeader, paneRow, chip/rowChip, paneIconButton, PaneNoticeStrip, PaneEmptyView).
Do pick corner radii from MarvinTheme.Radius (3 / 5 / 6).
Do give every status color a glyph, and keep at most one accent-filled chip per group.
Do keep a pane's intrinsic width at zero because all seven panes stay mounted.
Do honor Reduce Motion by dropping scale effects.
Do set machine-flavored text in SF Mono.
donts: Don't make a primary action look like text.
Don't add a height transition inside a pane slot, or .textSelection on a ScrollView-rooted left-pane view.
Don't tint the user bubble with the accent.
Don't use a bare Spacer() in a header row.
Don't introduce shadows or materials without a reason; the system has one of each.
